scales.question: How does the human mainline connect history, daily life, innovation and public value?
Where do the four value chains meet ordinary movement, care, work and maintenance?
Can each key area show ordinary entry, human fallback and a bounded machine lane?
Can consent, pause, appeal, repair and public retention be read at the interface?
scales.evidence: relative interface logic, pending professional review

scales.question: Can a release note, human takeover and removable component be understood at handoff?

alternatives.label: machine-first operating belt
alternatives.reason: A machine-first belt turns API calls, displays and test lanes into the public default, pushing ordinary movement, community retention and human judgement behind the interface.
alternatives.spatial_move: one continuous technology frontage with shared public space as overflow

alternatives.label: four value-chain rooms
alternatives.reason: Separate rooms clarify program but fragment the mainline, public appeal and cross-chain maintenance; a city operating system cannot end at room boundaries.
alternatives.ordinary_return: ordinary route retained, shared release unclear
alternatives.spatial_move: four isolated program rooms with independent release notices

alternatives.label: human mainline plus bounded machine lanes
alternatives.reason: The human mainline, ordinary and accessible service, community repair and public release remain first-class while API, robot and low-air concepts stay bounded, reversible and reviewable.
alternatives.ordinary_return: ordinary, accessible, staffed and paper routes remain protected
alternatives.spatial_move: one human mainline, three key-area interfaces and removable machine lanes

nodes.role: community retention, skills transition and screen-free daily service
nodes.resident_protection: ordinary walking, paper/phone entry and human consultation remain open

nodes.role: least-privilege API, bounded testing and human incident stop
nodes.resident_protection: pedestrian priority, visible takeover and safe retreat remain open

nodes.role: cultural explanation, international service and public release record
nodes.resident_protection: ordinary passage, multilingual human help and appeal remain open

rights_matrix.ordinary_service: walk, staffed help and physical wayfinding remain available
paper, phone, voice and face-to-face service can complete the task
rights_matrix.service_condition: no account or data call is required

rights_matrix.ordinary_service: purpose, refusal, pause, appeal and withdrawal are visible
repair, temporary use and public benefit remain available
passage, service and minimal release records survive withdrawal
rights_matrix.failure_action: retain public asset, clear excess data and stop
